data.description:
Follow-up recorded by ae96-f114-5363-4d57, which brought `scripts/` under `ruff check` and `ruff format` but NOT under mypy.

`Makefile` runs `mypy src/rebar`, so the 41 files in `scripts/` remain untyped and unchecked. Seven of them are invoked directly by `.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml`, the blocking workflow behind the `Verified` vote, so the gate implementations are type-unchecked even though they are now lint-clean.

ae96 also measured the structural obstacle: **17 of the 24 remaining irreducible exceptions in scripts/ are `E402`**, caused by ~6 scripts mutating `sys.path` before importing so they can reach into `src/rebar/_engine` and `tests/unit` by path. Those same bootstraps are what would make a naive `mypy scripts/` noisy — the import graph is not the packaged one. So this is not a one-line Makefile change; the packaging smell has to be addressed first or explicitly excluded.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A decision is recorded: either `scripts/` joins the typecheck scope, or it is explicitly and durably excluded with the reason
- [ ] If included: `make typecheck` covers `scripts/` and is green, and the `sys.path` bootstraps are either removed or accommodated without blanket ignores
- [ ] If excluded: the exclusion is stated where a reader of the Makefile will see it, not left implicit
- [ ] The seven CI-invoked scripts are covered either way, since they gate the Verified vote
data.title: Type-check scripts/ too: make typecheck is still mypy src/rebar only
